title: Photo Album for Best Friend: Birthday Gift Ideas | Albums.ink
desc: Photo album for your best friend's birthday: what to include, caption ideas, voice notes and a link they can open on their phone. Free, no ads.
h1: Photo album for your best friend: a birthday gift full of your story
lead: Look up “photo album for best friend” in Australia and you'll mostly find personalised photo books. They're great, but they can't hold the video from your road trip down the coast or your voice retelling the night you missed the last train. An online story album can — and you can make it tonight for free.
body: ## What to put in a best friend photo album
- How you met: the school photo, uni orientation, the first job where you sat next to each other.
- Big trips: Schoolies, a road trip, a weekend camping, the festival where it rained the whole time.
- Everyday stuff: brunch spots, beach days, the group chat moments worth keeping.
- Milestones: 18th and 21st birthdays, moving out, weddings, new babies.
- Messages from others: a few lines from family or friends who know you both.
- One caption per photo: inside jokes are the best part.
## Make it a free story album

On Albums you create a story album with chapters, photos, videos and voice notes, and play it back as a slideshow with your narration. To share it, add your best friend as a friend and choose Friends — that includes all your friends, so to show it only to them choose Friends, except… and exclude the others. Check again after you add new friends. Only me does not give access through a link. No ads, and the album stays as long as you want it.
1. Create a free album — e.g. “Ten years of us”.
2. Add chapters: School days, Trips, Birthdays, What's next.
3. Upload photos (up to 30 MB each; the free plan keeps up to 2048 px on the long edge) and short videos (up to 50 MB).
4. Record a voice note in the browser or upload audio (up to 20 MB).
5. Want another mate to help? Invite one co-author who is already your friend on Albums.
More ideas: photo dump ideas and how to add your voice to photos.

Play the slideshow at their birthday dinner or send the link with a card. They open it in the browser on their phone or laptop and sign in with Google. You can also download the whole album as one ZIP to keep a copy.
